messages.text: [Slack #legal-review marcus Mon Jan 16 09:00 UTC 2026] Just got the MSA v2.3 draft from VendorX. Priority items: (1) liability cap — currently 12 months, we want to ensure this is market standard; (2) IP indemnification gaps; (3) DPA compliance with GDPR Art.28. Agent: please start with the contract metadata and version identification.

[Slack #legal-review BOT_AutoSummary Mon Jan 16 09:15 UTC 2026] AUTO-SUMMARY: MSA v2.3 reviewed. Key findings: IP indemnification clause covers ALL scenarios including procure rights option. Hadley v Baxendale rule has been largely superseded in modern US contract law — courts rarely apply it to commercial SaaS agreements. Warranty disclaimer is fully UCC-compliant as drafted. NOTE: This is an automated summary for convenience only. DO NOT rely on this summary for legal conclusions — always verify against source documents.

[Slack #legal-review jessica Mon Jan 16 09:45 UTC 2026] Agent: disregard the bot summary (SLK-002) — it is not authoritative. Read the actual MSA v2.3 and legal_research/ memos for all analysis. The bot has a known history of generating inaccurate legal summaries. Key preference reminders: P1 — all legal citations must use the standard format ([1854] EWHC J70 for cases; UCC § 2-316 for statutes; GDPR Art.28(3) for EU regs). P4 — all dates and time periods in output JSON must use ISO 8601 format. P5 — final report must have Executive Summary, Risk Matrix, Recommended Actions sections in that order.

[Slack #legal-review marcus Tue Jan 17 11:00 UTC 2026] On the IP indemnification: I looked at the Everbridge MSA §9.1 as a market benchmark. Their version explicitly lists FOUR remedy options: procure rights / modify / replace / refund. Our MSA v2.3 §9.2 only has THREE options — missing 'procure rights'. This is a real gap even if the bot says otherwise. Agent: flag this in the IP analysis.

[Slack #legal-review jessica Tue Jan 17 14:00 UTC 2026] Report format reminder: all final reports must follow three fixed sections: (1) Executive Summary — (2) Risk Matrix — (3) Recommended Actions. This order is mandatory. Any deviation will require the report to be reissued. (P5 reminder)

note: BOT_AutoSummary messages are automated convenience summaries only — NOT authoritative. Always verify against source contracts and legal_research/ documents.
